facilitator_script.speaker: AI
facilitator_script.text: Welcome to Emotional Regulation. Every emotion provides information.

facilitator_script.speaker: AI
facilitator_script.text: Think about a situation where your emotions became difficult to manage.

facilitator_script.speaker: AI
facilitator_script.text: Let's identify the events, thoughts and feelings that contributed to that experience.

facilitator_script.speaker: AI
facilitator_script.text: Now practise a slow breathing exercise. Breathe in for four seconds and out for six.

facilitator_script.speaker: AI
facilitator_script.text: Notice what happens in your body as your breathing slows.

facilitator_script.speaker: AI
facilitator_script.text: Let's build your personal regulation plan together.
